store.summary: 60fps wireless A/V casting, mirroring & web console | 60帧音视频投屏与网页控台
store.description: Self-hosted web console (:8787) and low-latency wireless audio/video & screen-casting receiver for CardputerZero (320x170 RGB565). Stream synchronized movies and audio via one-line ffmpeg MJPEG/AVI (/stream), PC hybrid delta streamer (CP0S), direct curl .mp4/.wav upload (/play), or local browser video/audio casting with 0-150% volume control. Also supports drag-drop/Ctrl+V image push, 10 built-in UI/photo/calibration test patterns, live Bayer dither & rotation tuning, /tmp RAM diagnostic logging, En/Cn UI switch, and keypad shortcuts (4-8, M/-/+ volume, ESC).

zh-CN.description: 面向 CardputerZero（320×170 RGB565）的一体化双栏网页控台与低延迟无线音视频投屏接收应用。支持一行 ffmpeg 轻量 MJPEG 音画合流（/stream）、PC 端 CP0S 自适应混合差分推流、curl 直传 .mp4/.wav 播放（/play）以及浏览器本地音视频文件直接投播，内置 0–150% 数字音量与静音控制。同时支持拖拽或 Ctrl+V 粘贴截图上屏、10 类内置 UI/照片/标定样张、色彩量化与 Bayer 防色带抖动实时调节、1–120 FPS 稳帧、/tmp 内存盘按秒性能诊断日志、中英双语切换及机身物理快捷键。
